# The PFTC model

The courses teach data collection, curation, analysis, documentation, storage, and reuse.
They also show reproducible workflows, so the research can be checked and used again.
The topics sit in plant functional trait ecology, ecosystem ecology, plant physiology, and remote sensing.

The wheel is that path.
Choose a step, a part of the cycle, or a course band to open the matching chapter.
